Home/Installation

Window treatment installation in Los Angeles

Even the most beautiful shade, shutter or blind needs to fit well to look right and work properly. Careful measuring and installation are among the most important parts of the job. Start with a free in-home consultation: we bring samples to your home and take measurements for your windows.

Request a free in-home visit(818) 884-5464

A good fit takes more than width and height.

We measure the width at several points up the window and the height at several points across it. We also check whether the opening is square and level. One width and one height don’t tell the whole story.

Mounting depth, trim, handles and room for the treatment to move all matter too. Without the right fit, a treatment can look uneven or fail to open and close smoothly.

At installation, we check the mounting brackets, alignment and operation, as well as how the finished treatment looks in the window. With drapery, we also check how the fabric hangs and where the panels sit when open.

Questions about window treatment installation

Ask John: (818) 884-5464
How do I get started with installation?

Start with a free in-home consultation. We bring samples to your home, take measurements and help you choose the treatments. We then plan installation around your selections.

Can you install curtain rods and drapery tracks?

Yes. We look at the span, mounting points, brackets and room for the fabric to move, then fit the hardware and drapery for the planned arrangement.

Can you help set up motorized shades?

Yes, for compatible products and controls. We can help with control and hub setup, and discuss coordination with your electrician if you choose a hardwired system.
